title: Vitamin D supplementation and respiratory infection risk in older adults
abstract: BACKGROUND: Vitamin D has immunomodulatory effects. METHODS: We randomized 1,200 adults aged 65 years or older to vitamin D or placebo. RESULTS: Respiratory infection occurred in 12.5% of the vitamin D group and 15.8% of the placebo group (p = 0.04). CONCLUSIONS: Vitamin D supplementation modestly reduced respiratory infection incidence in this population.

text: We evaluated vitamin D supplementation in community-dwelling adults. No statistically significant reduction in respiratory infection was observed during 12 months of follow-up.
